divergences.why: the approved draft names each walk figure by slug, in brackets, the way a paper names a numbered figure; this site numbers no figures and anchors none, so a reference to one is positional, as it is everywhere else on the page
the master numbers the four goals as a markdown list; the page sets them as an <ol>, so a reader sees the same numbers and the words the comparison reads do not carry them

divergences.master: a magnification of a few trillion
divergences.page: a magnification of about eight trillion
divergences.why: placement verification: the engine's floor at 1280 wide near the main body is 4 ulps of 2^-53 a sample, 5.7e-13, and the whole-set home view is 4.4 wide, so the magnification is 7.7e12; escape-time fractals says around ten trillion, which this now agrees with

divergences.master: In practice it works down to widths of about 10<sup>−30</sup>.
divergences.page: In practice it works down to widths of about 10<sup>−30</sup> close to a minibrot, where the ceiling on iterations runs out first, and to about 10<sup>−50</sup> elsewhere, where a coordinate outgrows the 64 characters its link can carry.
divergences.why: placement verification: perturb-wasm's README puts 1e-30 where a minibrot tile needs more than the million-iteration ceiling, and renders ordinary frames at 1e-40 and 1e-54, where the link's 64-character coordinate is what stops them
